title: A Feature Selection Layer Approach for Multi-Class Classification on Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the age of data-driven decision-making, deep learning models have become powerful tools for uncovering patterns and making predictions that influence many aspects of society. However, their broader adoption in scientific and business applications is often limited by a lack of interpretability. Feature weighting methods, which assess the relevance of individual features, are among the most widely studied approaches for improving interpretability. While post hoc techniques have advanced significantly, especially in modeling nuanced relationships between features and labels in multiclass problems, embedded methods typically fall short in this regard. Embedded techniques integrate feature relevance learning directly into the model training process, but they are often unable to capture label-specific relationships. translated_title: 一种用于神经网络多分类的特征选择层方法
translated_abstract: 在数据驱动决策的时代，深度学习模型已成为揭示模式和进行预测的强大工具，影响着社会的许多方面。然而，它们在科学和商业应用中的更广泛采用往往受到可解释性不足的限制。特征加权方法通过评估单个特征的相关性，是提高可解释性方面被研究最多的方法之一。虽然事后方法已经取得了显著进展，特别是在建模多分类问题中特征与标签之间的细微关系方面，但嵌入式方法在这方面通常表现不足。嵌入式技术将特征相关性学习直接集成到模型训练过程中，但它们往往无法捕捉特定标签的关系。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了对特征选择层的多种扩展，这是一种嵌入式特征加权机制。
tldr: 提出了对特征选择层的多种扩展，使嵌入式特征加权机制能够在多分类任务中捕捉特定标签的特征关系，从而提升神经网络的可解释性。
en_tdlr: Proposes multiple extensions to the Feature Selection Layer, enabling embedded feature weighting mechanisms to capture label-specific relationships in multi-class classification, thereby improving the interpretability of neural networks.
